1_geometry.rule: λ=1 < TLJ-A in phrase-graph TV and PH bottleneck (needs TLJ-A)

2_statistics.rule: λ=1 < TLJ-A and R2 in interval/duration/4-gram JSD, OA larger (needs TLJ-A, R2)

3_music.rule: λ=1 ≤ TLJ-A in out-of-scale, beat-fill and cadence violations (needs TLJ-A)

4_novelty.rule: authenticity ≥ T2-0.3, |Z_CT| < 2 on measures not identical to a training measure (exact share reported against the piece's repeat rate), density > R0, R1, R2, TLJ-A (only |Z| judged now)

5_graph_loss.rule: λ=1 > λ=0 in first-pass membership for every training seed
